newsitem.title: USA: Therma-Wave Inc sells $115 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Therma-Wave Inc sells $115 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement offering from Therma-Wave Inc was priced on Friday via BT Securities Inc, market sources said.
